fusions.name: Tumbleweed Stampede
fusions.desc: Sends a rolling stampede of tumbleweed across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to every enemy in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Rolling Seedhead
fusions.desc: Bowls a spiny seedhead at one enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 7 damage, more the further it rolls, up to 1.6 times. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Wild Oat Run
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Burr Wake
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a spiny seed flies at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
